name: Ralf
source_filename: Ralf - Posterior/Anterior A-B, common machines (coach build 2026-08-31)

exercises.name: Barbell SLDL
exercises.coach_note: Hinge at the hips, bar stays close to the legs, stop when the hamstrings are fully stretched. Same weight both sets.

exercises.name: Lying Hamstring Curl
exercises.coach_note: Hips stay pinned to the pad, get full range. If there is no lying curl, use the seated one.

exercises.name: Close Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.coach_note: V-handle or close neutral grip. Dont lean back alot, keep forearms vertically straight.

exercises.name: Chest Supported Dumbbell Row
exercises.coach_note: Incline bench set to about 30-45 degrees, chest on the pad. Elbows tucked, pull to the hips.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction Machine
exercises.coach_note: Ensure full range of motion on all reps, sit upright

exercises.name: Hip Adduction Machine
exercises.coach_note: Sit upright, full range on every rep, control the opening.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.coach_note: Stay stable, drive elbows up, minimize shrugging

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.coach_note: Face the pad, arms slightly bent, lead with the elbows. Light weight, feel it in the rear delts not the traps.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
exercises.coach_note: Balls of the feet on a step or plate, dumbbell in hand. Full stretch at the bottom, pause, drive up.

exercises.name: Ab Curl Machine
exercises.coach_note: If the gym has no ab machine, do cable crunches on the rope instead.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.coach_note: Handles level with mid chest. Full stretch at the back, extend elbows at the front.

exercises.name: Mid Chest Cable Fly
exercises.coach_note: Pulleys at shoulder height. Slight elbow bend held constant, bring the hands together in front of the chest.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat
exercises.coach_note: Feet slightly forward of the bar, heels down. Drive through whole foot, go as deep as you can with the heels down.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.coach_note: Pull hips down into seat, extend fully and go all the way down

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.coach_note: Seated, back supported. Dumbbells start at ear level, press to lockout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.coach_note: Stay stable, drive elbows up and minimize shrugging

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Tricep Extension
exercises.coach_note: Both hands on one dumbbell. Get a full stretch at the bottom, elbows pointing forward.

exercises.name: Straight Bar Tricep Push Down
exercises.coach_note: Elbows fixed at the sides, lock out fully at the bottom.

exercises.name: EZ Bar Preacher Curl
exercises.coach_note: Ensure elbow stays fixed, go all the way down

exercises.name: Standing Dumbbell Curl
exercises.coach_note: Elbows stay at the sides, no swinging, full range at the bottom.
